The Epicgadget(TM) Quick-Dry Water Shoes seem to have some great features that fit your needs:

- Lightweight, flexible, and comfortable water shoes that are quick-drying
- Durable rubber soles provide good traction on slippery surfaces
- Stretchy, breathable fabric that retains its shape
- Suitable for a variety of water sports like swimming, diving, snorkeling, etc.

Based on the 4.3-star average rating from 10 customer reviews, most buyers seem very satisfied with the quality and performance of these shoes. The positive reviews highlight how they work well for their intended purpose as a lightweight, affordable water shoe.

There is one 1-star review complaining about the size being too small, but overall the feedback is quite favorable. Let me know if you have any other questions!

top_reviews.title: Epicgadget(TM) Quick-Dry Water Shoe
top_reviews.text: These Epicgadget(TM) Quick-Dry Water Shoe are good.  I use them for iRacing as my racing shoes.

top_reviews.title: Serves a temporary purpose
top_reviews.text: I have used these before and they are a perfect cheap solution for a day-trip to the water park. I just ordered a week’s worth for the next weeklong vacation. They’ll keep the bottom of your feet from having your skin worn off by the concrete bottoms of pools, but don’t expect to wear them twice. They’re cheap enough that I don’t expect them to last more than a single use. And for that they are perfect. They’re also slim enough you roll them up and put them in your pocket when you get on rides where they make you leave your shoes on a rack at the entrance… no more going back to retrieve your shoes.

top_reviews.title: Tiny flat piece of rubber
top_reviews.text: Poor quality, child size--not size I ordered but it would have to be 5 times larger to be adult size. Then it would be impossible to fit one's foot inside. Piece of junk.
